questions.stem: If the equations −9x + y = 17 and 9x + y = 17 are graphed in the xy-plane, at what point (x, y) do the graphs intersect?
questions.verify: sympy: {x: 0, y: 17}

questions.stem: Rebecca is collecting 40-milliliter samples of river water and 15-milliliter samples of lake water. She needs to collect a total of at least 770 milliliters of river water and lake water, where the number of samples of lake water is twice the number of samples of river water. Which inequality represents this situation, where x is the number of samples of river water that Rebecca needs to collect?
questions.verify: x river samples at 40 mL, 2x lake samples at 15 mL; 'at least' gives >=

Data set123456789
J181819192021212222

The lists give the values in data sets J and K. Which of the following statistics is greater for data set J than it is for data set K?
questions.verify: means 20/20, medians 20/20, ranges 4/4, population SD 1.491 vs 0.943

questions.stem: \[4x^{2}-4x-24=0\]What is the product of the solutions to the given equation?
questions.verify: sympy roots [-2, 3], product -6

questions.stem: \[y=4x+36\]One of the two equations in a system of linear equations is given. The system has infinitely many solutions. Which equation could be the second equation in this system?
questions.verify: sympy: B infinitely many, A no solution, C and D one point

questions.stem: An artist made 14 pieces of pottery using 48 pounds of clay. The pottery included only bowls and vases. Each bowl used 3 pounds of clay and each vase used 5 pounds of clay. How many vases did the artist make?
\[-5(v-8)(v-2)(v+9)=0\]What value of v is a solution to the given equation?
questions.verify: sympy roots [-9, 2, 8]; only 8 is a choice

questions.stem: In the xy-plane, an equation of circle R is \((x+8)^{2}+(y+19)^{2}=100\). Circle S is obtained by shifting circle R to the right 3 units. An equation defining circle S is \((x+h)^{2}+(y+k)^{2}=100\), where h and k are constants. What is the value of h?
If \((x+3)^{2}=30\), what is the value of \(x^{2}+6x\)?
questions.verify: sympy: x^2 + 6x = 21 for both roots

questions.stem: A machine fills bags with approximately 11 ounces of walnuts. To test the accuracy of the filling process, 330 bags of walnuts were selected at random and weighed. Based on the sample, it is estimated that the average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine in an 8-hour period is 11.17 ounces, with an associated margin of error of 0.2 ounce. Which of the following is the best interpretation of this estimate?
choices: Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine are between 10.97 ounces and 11.37 ounces.
Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine are less than 10.97 ounces or greater than 11.37 ounces.
The average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine is less than 11.02 ounces.
The average weight of all bags of walnuts filled by the machine is greater than 11.02 ounces.

questions.stem: The equation \(E(t)=5(1.8)^{t}\) gives the estimated number of employees at a restaurant, where t is the number of years since the restaurant opened. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 5 in this context?
choices: The estimated number of employees when the restaurant opened
The increase in the estimated number of employees each year
The number of years the restaurant has been open
The percent increase in the estimated number of employees each year

questions.stem: Rectangle X has a length of 24 millimeters (mm) and a width of 7.5 mm. Right triangle Y has a base of 60 mm. The area of rectangle X is 3 times the area of right triangle Y. What is the height, in mm, of right triangle Y?

At a convention center, there are a total of 375 visitors. Each visitor is located in either room A, room B, or room C. If one of these visitors is selected at random, the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room A is 0.48, and the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in room B is 0.28. How many visitors are located in room C?
For the polynomial function f, when f(x) is divided by x − 8, the remainder is 9. Which of the following must be true about the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?
questions.verify: remainder theorem: f(8) = 9; sympy check on a sample f

questions.stem: A machine makes 9-inch, 8-inch, and 3-inch parts. During a certain day, the number of 9-inch parts that the machine makes is 4 times the number n of 8-inch parts, and the number of 3-inch parts is 15. During this day, the machine makes 100 parts total. Which equation represents this situation?
questions.verify: count of parts: 4n + n + 15 = 100 (n = 17); A totals inches and gives n = 5/4

questions.stem: A city has an area of x square miles and a population density of 1,035 people per square mile. The suburb adjacent to the city has an area of y square miles and a population density of 535 people per square mile. The combined population of the city and the suburb adjacent to the city is 13,165 people. Which equation represents this situation?
questions.verify: population = density x area for each region, summed

questions.stem: For two acute angles A and B, \(\cos A-\sin B=0\). The measure of angle A is x degrees, where 8x − 13 = 321. What is the measure of angle B, in degrees?
questions.verify: sympy: x = 167/4 = 41.75, B = 90 - A = 48.25; cos A - sin B = 0 checked

questions.stem: \[r>0.54t\]The given inequality describes the total rainfall r, in inches, in a certain area over a period of t hours, where \(t\le 4\). Which of the following describes this rainfall?
choices: An average rainfall of exactly 0.54 inches per hour
An average rainfall of more than 0.54 inches per hour
A total rainfall of more than 4 inches
A total rainfall of exactly 4 inches

questions.stem: \[12x+8=k(6x+8)+6x\]In the given equation, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one solution. Which value CANNOT be the value of k?
questions.verify: sympy: k = 1 gives no solution; -1, 0, 2 give x = -4/3

questions.stem: \[-4x^{2}+bx-25=0\]In the given equation, b is a positive integer. The equation has no real solution. What is the largest possible value of b?
questions.verify: discriminant b^2 - 400 < 0 -> b < 20; largest integer 19

questions.stem: A quadratic function models the height, in feet, of an object above the ground in terms of the time, in seconds, after the object was launched. The model estimates that the object was launched from an initial height of 0.00 feet above the ground and was at a maximum height of 207.36 feet above the ground 3.6 seconds after it was launched. The model also estimates that the object was at a height of 184.32 feet above the ground x seconds after it was launched. What is a possible value of x?
For the polynomial function f, the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane passes through the points (−5, 0), (3, 0), and (8, 0). Which of the following must be a factor of f(x)?
questions.verify: zero at x = 3 -> factor (x - 3); the zeros -5 and 8 would give x + 5 and x - 8, not offered
